titre: Demandes de prestations traitées par les Anciens combattants
sous_titre: millions de demandes traitées, exercices 2024 à 2026, exercice 2026 arrêté au 1er juin

2024.texte: In fiscal year 2024, VA processed a total of 2,517,519 ratings claims

2025.texte: By the end of fiscal 25, VA had completed more than 3 million claims, the most in history.

2026.texte: it processed more than two million disability benefits claims for veterans in fiscal year 2026 as of June 1, 2026
